recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆淋巴球的細胞核深度分葉成多個花瓣狀，染色質濃縮，胞質嗜鹼性，這就是典型的「花細胞」（flower cell），是成人 T 細胞白血病/淋巴瘤的代表形態。
features: Nucleus deeply lobulated into multiple petal-like lobes (flower/cloverleaf shape)
Condensed, clumped chromatin without visible nucleoli
Thin rim of basophilic, agranular cytoplasm
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an atypical medium-sized lymphocyte with a markedly polylobated, petal-like nucleus, condensed chromatin, no conspicuous nucleoli, and a scant rim of basophilic cytoplasm. Surrounding erythrocytes are unremarkable in this field. Findings are consistent with a 'flower cell' of adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma; confirmation by HTLV-1 serology and a CD4+/CD25+/CD7- immunophenotype is recommended.

ddx.vs: Sézary cells have a cerebriform nucleus with fine grooves rather than deep clefts separating discrete petal-like lobes, and patients are HTLV-1 negative.
Neutrophils have pink granular cytoplasm and lobes joined by thin chromatin strands, not a basophilic agranular rim.
T-PLL cells usually have a single visible nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs, with TCL1 expression rather than CD25.
CLL cells are B cells (CD5+/CD23+/CD20 dim) and only occasionally show a single notch rather than multilobation.
